head: 1430d42
summary: Confirmation round on 1430d42. Verified: git diff 5e5e561..1430d42 -- src/ touches only 04_shaders.js and 12_scene.js; 10_mono.js and 05_layout.js are unchanged, so the monument geometry, materials and atlas are byte-identical to the rated w22b. Luminance check: |dL|>8 affects 0.00-2.56 % of pixels (q01 2.56, m02 1.69, q13 1.22, m05 0.32, the others 0.00), which confirms the integrator's figure. But the integrator's luminance-only diff misses a hue change. Pixels with |d(B-R)|>8: q13 28.2 %, m12 24.3 %, q19 20.6 %, m09 10.0 %, m02 8.5 %, q11 6.9 %, m06 5.3 %. The bar (q11/m05/m06), the welcome galley (m03) and the F front wall are unaffected in tone and hue on the monument surfaces themselves: the bar elements re-measure exactly as in w22b (ovens p50 136, pane 38/42/67, control panel 139, counter 25, right bay 3, nosing 217). Door 1 (q01) changes slightly for the better: the belt-height hot band on the door's inner panel (L227-229 against 208 above it) is now 213-216, so the panel falls off evenly. One lighting regression on monuments: L14's PY/Y seat-level cool light (seatCool/bleed, z > u_sLowZ, below 1.2-1.5 m) also lands on the door-4 and door-5 galleys. Their lower faces turn lavender: q19 back wall under the counter B-R -6 -> +7, lower drawers -6 -> +7, m12 bottom -2 -> +8, m09 lower white panel -2 -> +6..+12. Meanwhile the inserts above 1.3 m stay neutral (-5 to -1), which splits a single white galley face in two at about 1.3 m (q19 column profile: rows 150-275 B-R -1, rows 325-550 +6..+12). That is lighting, so it is not scored, but it is flagged medium for the integrator. Monuments score holds at 8.7 on geometry, proportion, colour, materials and detail. There is no high issue. The w22b lows all carry, unchanged.
lighting_note: (1) Medium, new in L14. seatCool / bleed (04_shaders.js mainFS: seatC = u_seatCool * step(u_sLowZ, z) * (1 - smoothstep(1.2, 1.5, y)) * (1 - coolW); bounce *= mix(1, u_bleed, step(u_sLowZ, z) * (1 - smoothstep(0.9, 1.3, y)) * ...)) are keyed only on z and height. They therefore tint the door-4 and door-5 galleys, carts and the lower galley walls with the PY/Y seat-block blue, where no seat block exists and galley task lighting is neutral. Measured in Boarding: q19 below-counter wall B-R -6 -> +7 (L 197 -> 200), q19 lower drawers -6 -> +7, left carts -6 -> +8, m12 lower half -2 -> +8 (p90 +13), m09 lower white panel -2 -> +6 (p90 +11). The upper inserts stay -5 / -1, which makes a visible two-tone face with the transition at 1.2-1.5 m (m09 pair: lower panel lavender, inserts above grey-neutral). (2) Carried: the open bays are crushed (m05 right bay L3 vs j32 L11), the q11 counter picks up the canopy sheen (p50 53 vs photo 23-34 frontal), and the q11 ash doors are L172 vs the photos' L130-161 (exposure). (3) Improved: the door-1 inner panel belt hot band is gone (q01 x258 column: 227/228/229 -> 214/215/216 at rows 263-287, rows 215-240 and 347+ unchanged).

calibration.issue: Lighting-only change since w22b: did it regress the monuments?
calibration.evidence: Only 04_shaders.js and 12_scene.js changed (git diff 5e5e561 1430d42 -- src/). The luminance diff matches the integrator's claim: max 2.56 % at |dL|>8. The hue diff does not: q19 20.6 %, m12 24.3 %, m09 10.0 % of pixels have |d(B-R)|>8, all below about 1.3 m in the rear and door-4 galleys (seatCool/bleed). The bar, the welcome galley and the F wall are unchanged in tone and hue on monument surfaces. The m05/m02 left-edge B-R shifts (+5 -> +20) are cabin windows in the background, not monuments. Door 1 improved (belt hot band removed).

calibration.evidence: m05 pane (655-780,180-400) p10/50/90 38/42/67, identical to w22b; omaat_j32 pane (760-900,200-680) re-measured from a fresh download: 31/60/83. Crisp shelf lines and box outlines are still legible; the stile is still about 2 % of the width.

w22b B low: counter nosing is a flat white band, not a satin rail
calibration.evidence: m05 (100-700,500-512) p10/50/90 216/217/236. The j32 rail is a grey satin aluminium rail with a highlight line.

w22b B low: simplified oven fronts
calibration.evidence: m05 ovens p50 136 (j32 138, tone matches); still a flat face, square cream tag and straight handle. j32 has a round recessed dish with a lever and blue tags.

calibration.issue: w22b A low: door-2 welcome galley identical to the bar face
calibration.evidence: serviceFace still shared; m03 is pixel-identical to w22b (|dL|>8 0.00 %, |dB-R|>8 0.07 %).

calibration.evidence: Geometry and atlas unchanged; q01/m02 changes are confined to the belt dimming, with no change to the print or lav doors.

calibration.issue: Earlier mediums (L13 bar in-service face; w22b ink-print inversion; w19b warm drapes)
calibration.evidence: The bar matches omaat_j32 in layout (re-downloaded and compared side by side: control panel and two ovens left, monitor over brewer and bottle bays, glass-door cabinet with round latch right, black counter). The w21 ink print and the drapes are unchanged.

issues.issue: Lighting regression (integrator's file, not scored for monuments): the L14 PY/Y seat-level cool light and seat-block bleed tint the door-4 and door-5 galleys lavender below about 1.3 m, which splits each white galley face into a cool lower half and a neutral upper half.
issues.evidence: Old -> new B-R p50 at near-constant L: q19 below-counter wall -6 -> +7 (p90 -1 -> +14), lower drawers -6 -> +7, left carts -6 -> +8; m12 lower half -2 -> +8; m09 lower white panel -2 -> +6. The upper inserts stay -5 / -1. q19 column x605-640: rows 150-275 B-R -1, rows 325-550 +6..+12. There are no seats in the galleys for the blue to bounce off; galley task lights are neutral.
issues.fix: 04_shaders.js / 12_scene.js (integrator): restrict seatC and the u_bleed term to the seated zones, not just z > u_sLowZ. Either add an upper z bound plus the door-4 galley z-range exclusion from layout zones (e.g. pass the PY/Y seat-block z intervals as a small uniform array), or gate both by a per-vertex 'monument' flag (the Builder already bakes material; a MONMAT-wide flag of 0 for seatC/bleed would cover galleys, lavs and partitions). Re-check q19/m12/m09: lower faces back to B-R about -2..-6.
